Summary: Verify the login page loads over HTTPS with all login controls and correct default states
Requirement Reference:
PRD > Current State Analysis > Existing Features (Standard Authentication Fields; Remember Me Functionality; Account Registration Link)
PRD > User Experience Features > Interface Design > Auto-focus
PRD > Technical Requirements > Data Protection > HTTPS Enforcement
Description: Confirms that a user who opens app.vwo.com reaches the secure login page, that every login control is present, that the cursor starts in the Email address field, and that the password stays masked until the user reveals it.
Preconditions:
1. A new Chrome Incognito window is open (no VWO session or cookies).
2. The tester has internet access to app.vwo.com.
Test Steps:
1. Type http://app.vwo.com/ in the address bar and press Enter.
2. Check the browser tab title.
3. Without clicking anything, check which field has the blinking cursor.
4. Check the controls displayed on the login form.
5. Check the "Remember me" checkbox and check the page for any error message.
6. Click in the "Password" field and type the test password. Do not submit.
7. Click the eye icon (Toggle password visibility) next to the Password field.
8. Click the eye icon again.
Test Data:
URL: http://app.vwo.com/
Password (typed only, never submitted): Sample#Pass123
Expected Result:
Step 1: The browser is redirected to https://app.vwo.com/#/login.
Step 2: The tab title is "Login - Wingify".
Step 3: The cursor is in the "Email address" field.
Step 4: The form shows the "Email address" field, the "Password" field, "Forgot Password?", the "Remember me" checkbox, "Sign in", "Sign in with Google", "Sign in using SSO", "Sign in with Passkey" and the "Start a free trial" link.
Step 5: "Remember me" is unchecked and no error message is displayed.
Step 6: The typed characters are masked.
Step 7: The password is shown as readable text.
Step 8: The password is masked again.
Evidence Source: OBS-01, OBS-02, OBS-03, OBS-05 (live page, app.vwo.com, 24-Nov-2026). Step 8 also covered by automated TC_V03 (app.wingify.com, 20-Nov-2026).
Verification Status: Verified on the live page. "Sign in with Passkey" and the eye icon are on the page but not in the PRD (GAP-25, GAP-26).
Environment: Production: https://app.vwo.com/#/login | Desktop Google Chrome (latest stable) | Windows 11 | Window 1280x720 or larger
